items.text: Karkidaka Chikitsa is performed during the Karkidakam month (July–August) of the Malayalam calendar — the peak of Kerala's monsoon and, by classical Ayurvedic teaching, the most powerful healing window of the year.

items.text: Also known as Karkidaka Ayurveda Treatment, this is a traditional monsoon Ayurvedic treatment from Kerala. According to Ayurveda, this window is ideal for deep detoxification and rejuvenation, as the body becomes more receptive to therapies in the cooler, humid climate — allowing treatments to work at a deeper level on your tissues and doshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha).
